class.name: AudioStreamPlaybackOpenMPT
class.description:
Provides playback control for tracker music, including tempo/pitch control, looping, and pattern navigation. [b]Important:[/b] This object is only available after calling [method AudioStreamPlayer.play]. Call [method AudioStreamPlayer.get_stream_playback] to get the instance. [codeblock] var player = AudioStreamPlayer.new() player.stream = stream player.play()
# Now get playback control var playback = player.get_stream_playback() as AudioStreamPlaybackOpenMPT playback.set_tempo_factor(1.5) # 50% faster playback.set_repeat_count(-1) # Loop forever [/codeblock]

method.name: get_current_order
method.description: Returns the current order (song position) being played.

method.name: get_current_pattern
method.description: Returns the current pattern being played.

method.name: get_current_row
method.description: Returns the current row within the pattern being played.

method.name: get_pitch_factor
method.description: Returns the current pitch factor. Default is 1.0 (normal pitch).

method.name: get_position
method.description: Returns the current playback position in seconds.

method.name: get_repeat_count
method.description: Returns the current repeat count. -1 means loop forever, 0 means play once, positive values mean play that many times.

method.name: get_tempo_factor
method.description: Returns the current tempo factor. Default is 1.0 (normal speed).

method.name: set_pitch_factor
method.description: Sets the pitch factor. Values above 1.0 increase pitch, below 1.0 decrease pitch. [codeblock] playback.set_pitch_factor(1.5) # 50% higher pitch playback.set_pitch_factor(0.8) # 20% lower pitch [/codeblock]

method.name: set_position
method.description: Sets the playback position in seconds.

method.name: set_position_order_row
method.description: Jumps to a specific order (song position) and row within that order's pattern. [codeblock] playback.set_position_order_row(4, 0) # Jump to order 4, row 0 print("Now at pattern: ", playback.get_current_pattern()) [/codeblock]

method.name: set_repeat_count
method.description: Sets how many times the module should repeat. Use -1 for infinite looping, 0 to play once, or a positive number to play that many times. [codeblock] playback.set_repeat_count(-1) # Loop forever playback.set_repeat_count(3) # Play 3 times then stop playback.set_repeat_count(0) # Play once [/codeblock]

method.name: set_tempo_factor
method.description: Sets the tempo factor. Values above 1.0 speed up playback, below 1.0 slow it down. [codeblock] playback.set_tempo_factor(1.5) # 50% faster playback.set_tempo_factor(0.5) # Half speed [/codeblock]
